description.zh:
任务唯一标识

> 
>- taskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的taskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话。
>- 建议手动赋值taskId，以便关联上下文。
description.en:
Unique identifier for the task.

> - Leave this field empty to let the system generate a taskId automatically. If you use the same taskId in later requests, those tasks belong to the same conversation.
>
> - Set a custom taskId to link related requests and maintain context.
